name: averos-dag-engine
description: AI-native deterministic software generation platform combining structured application manifests, DAG planning, workflow execution, MCP integration, and conversational application design.
author: averos-io<averos.tech@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/dag-engine && npm run build -w packages/executor && npm run build -w packages/ai && npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run build -w packages/mcp
scripts.build:deps: npm run build -w packages/dag-engine && npm run build -w packages/executor
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build:deps && npm run build -w packages/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run smoke:all && npm run integration:all
scripts.smoke:all: npm run smoke:plan && npm run smoke:run && npm run smoke:gr-plan && npm run smoke:gr-run
scripts.integration:all: npm run integration:executor && npm run integration:ai
scripts.release:local: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run pack
scripts.release:pack: npm run release:pack -w packages/dag-engine && npm run release:pack -w packages/executor && npm run release:pack -w packages/ai && npm run release:pack -w packages/cli && npm run release:pack -w packages/mcp
scripts.release:install-global: cd release && sudo npm install -g averos-dag-engine-1.0.0.tgz averos-executor-1.0.0.tgz averos-ai-1.0.0.tgz averos-mcp-1.0.0.tgz averos-cli-1.0.0.tgz
